    var out=await callGeminiFast("",hist,false,STU_PROMPT);
    var code=stuExtract(out);
    if(!code||code.length<200){throw new Error("empty")}
    var ferr=stuCheck(code),fixes=0;
    while(ferr&&fixes<2){
      fixes++;
      var fh=[{role:"user",parts:[{text:"Your previous app has this JavaScript error: "+ferr+" - return the FULL corrected complete app (single HTML file) with this error fixed."}]},{role:"user",parts:[{text:code}]}];
      out=await callGeminiFast("",fh,false,STU_PROMPT);
      var c2=stuExtract(out);
      if(!c2)break;
      code=c2;ferr=stuCheck(code);
    }
    STU.fixes=fixes;
    STU.code=code;
